ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
function deviceType() {
  try {
    return !!java.deviceID();
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}
let device = deviceType() ? 'ios' : 'android';
java.put("dev", device);

function transformChapters(result) {
    const sourceVar = source.getVariable();
    let debug = "0";

    if (sourceVar) {
        const debugMatch = sourceVar.match(/debug=([^&]+)/);
        if (debugMatch) {
            debug = debugMatch[1];
        }
    }

    // 解析 JSON 字符串
    const jsonData = JSON.parse(result);
    
    // 访问 Data 字段
    const data = jsonData.Data;
    const { BookId, CanReadFree, VipLen, TotalPrice, Volumes, Chapters } = data;
    if (debug === "1") {
        java.log("BookId: " + BookId);
        java.log("CanReadFree: " + CanReadFree);
        java.log("VipLen: " + VipLen);
        java.log("TotalPrice: " + TotalPrice);
        java.log("Volumes: " + JSON.stringify(Volumes));
        java.log("Chapters: " + JSON.stringify(Chapters));
    }

    // 创建卷的映射对象
    const volumeMap = {};
    for (let volIndex in Volumes) {
        const v = Volumes[volIndex];
        volumeMap[v.VolumeCode] = v.VolumeName;
    }

    // 遍历章节列表
    let transformedList = [];
    for (let chapterIndex in Chapters) {
        if (debug === "1") {
            java.log("Processing Chapter Index: " + chapterIndex);
        }
        let chapter = Chapters[chapterIndex];
        if (debug === "1") {
            java.log("Chapter Data: " + JSON.stringify(chapter));
        }
        let isVip = !(CanReadFree === 1) && (VipLen !== 0 || TotalPrice !== 0);

        let volumeCode = chapter.Vc;
        let volumeName = volumeMap[volumeCode];
        let isVolume = volumeName === chapter.N;

        let displayTime = chapter.DisplayTime;
        let formattedDate = '';
        if (displayTime && displayTime > 0) {
            formattedDate = java.timeFormat(displayTime );
        } else {
            formattedDate = '1970/01/01';
        }
        let wordCount = chapter.W || 0;
        let info = `${formattedDate} · ${wordCount}`;

        let chapterUrl = `data:chapter_info;base64,${java.base64Encode(String(BookId) + "," + String(chapter.C))},{"type":"qdreader"}`;

        transformedList.push({
            isVip: isVip,
            ChapterName: chapter.N,
            isVolume: isVolume,
            Info: info,
            ChapterId: chapter.C,
            ChapterUrl: chapterUrl
        });
        if (debug === "1") {
            java.log("Processed Chapter: " + JSON.stringify({
                isVip: isVip,
                ChapterName: chapter.N,
                isVolume: isVolume,
                Info: info,
                ChapterId: chapter.C,
                ChapterUrl: chapterUrl
            }));
        }  
    }

    if (debug === "1") {
        java.log("Transformed List: " + JSON.stringify(transformedList));
    }

    return transformedList;
}

transformChapters(result);
</js>
